name: type_inference_advanced.k
model:
class Point {
  x:Int = 0
  y:Int = 0
}

class Rectangle {
  width:Int = 10
  height:Int = 20
  area:Int = width * height
  perimeter:Int = 2 * (width + height)
}

sum:Int = 1 + 2

product:Int = 3 * 4

difference:Int = 10 - 5

isTrue:Bool = true

isFalse:Bool = false

andResult:Bool = isTrue && isFalse

orResult:Bool = isTrue || isFalse

isGreater:Bool = 5 > 3

isEqual:Bool = 10 = 10

piValue:Real = 3.14159E0

radius:Real = 2.5E0

circumference:Real = 2E0 * piValue * radius

p:Point

rect:Rectangle

px:Int = p.x

rectArea:Int = rect.area

req sum > 0

req isGreater = true

req rectArea > 0
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (sum Int)(product Int)(difference Int)(isTrue Bool)(isFalse Bool)(andResult Bool)(orResult Bool)(isGreater Bool)(isEqual Bool)(piValue Real)(radius Real)(circumference Real)(p Ref)(rect Ref)(px Int)(rectArea Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Point (mk-Point (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Rectangle (mk-Rectangle (width Int)(height Int)(area Int)(perimeter Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-Point (sel-Point Point))
  (lift-Rectangle (sel-Rectangle Rectangle))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Point ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Point (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Point ((this Ref)) Point
  (sel-Point (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Rectangle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Rectangle (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Rectangle ((this Ref)) Rectangle
  (sel-Rectangle (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Point ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Point this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Rectangle ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Rectangle this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.sum: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!sum ((this Ref)) Int
  (sum (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.product: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!product ((this Ref)) Int
  (product (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.difference: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!difference ((this Ref)) Int
  (difference (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.isTrue: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!isTrue ((this Ref)) Bool
  (isTrue (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.isFalse: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!isFalse ((this Ref)) Bool
  (isFalse (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.andResult: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!andResult ((this Ref)) Bool
  (andResult (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.orResult: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!orResult ((this Ref)) Bool
  (orResult (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.isGreater: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!isGreater ((this Ref)) Bool
  (isGreater (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.isEqual: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!isEqual ((this Ref)) Bool
  (isEqual (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.piValue: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!piValue ((this Ref)) Real
  (piValue (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.radius: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!radius ((this Ref)) Real
  (radius (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.circumference: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!circumference ((this Ref)) Real
  (circumference (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.p: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!p ((this Ref)) Ref
  (p (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.rect: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!rect ((this Ref)) Ref
  (rect (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.px: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!px ((this Ref)) Int
  (px (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.rectArea: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!rectArea ((this Ref)) Int
  (rectArea (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Point:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Point.x: ---

(define-fun Point.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-Point this))
)

(define-fun Point!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-Point this))
)

; --- getters for Point.y: ---

(define-fun Point!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-Point this))
)

; --------------------------------
;   Getters for class Rectangle:
; --------------------------------

; --- getters for Rectangle.width: ---

(define-fun Rectangle!width ((this Ref)) Int
  (width (deref-Rectangle this))
)

; --- getters for Rectangle.height: ---

(define-fun Rectangle!height ((this Ref)) Int
  (height (deref-Rectangle this))
)

; --- getters for Rectangle.area: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.area ((this Ref)) Int
  (area (deref-Rectangle this))
)

(define-fun Rectangle!area ((this Ref)) Int
  (area (deref-Rectangle this))
)

; --- getters for Rectangle.perimeter: ---

(define-fun Rectangle!perimeter ((this Ref)) Int
  (perimeter (deref-Rectangle this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!sum this) (+ 1 2))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!product this) (* 3 4))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!difference this) (- 10 5))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!isTrue this) true)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))

; --- Invariant 5: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!isFalse this) false)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv5 0) :named _xkassert4))

; --- Invariant 6: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!andResult this) (and (TopLevelDeclarations!isTrue this) (TopLevelDeclarations!isFalse this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv6 0) :named _xkassert5))

; --- Invariant 7: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!orResult this) (or (TopLevelDeclarations!isTrue this) (TopLevelDeclarations!isFalse this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv7 0) :named _xkassert6))

; --- Invariant 8: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv8 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!isGreater this) (> 5 3))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv8 0) :named _xkassert7))

; --- Invariant 9: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv9 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!isEqual this) (= 10 10))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv9 0) :named _xkassert8))

; --- Invariant 10: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv10 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!piValue this) 3.1415900000000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv10 0) :named _xkassert9))

; --- Invariant 11: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv11 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!radius this) 2.5000000000000000)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv11 0) :named _xkassert10))

; --- Invariant 12: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv12 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!circumference this) (* (* 2.0000000000000000 (TopLevelDeclarations!piValue this)) (TopLevelDeclarations!radius this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv12 0) :named _xkassert11))

; --- Invariant 13: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv13 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!px this) (Point.x (TopLevelDeclarations!p this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv13 0) :named _xkassert12))

; --- Invariant 14: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv14 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!rectArea this) (Rectangle.area (TopLevelDeclarations!rect this)))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv14 0) :named _xkassert13))

; --- Invariant 15: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv15 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Point (TopLevelDeclarations!p this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv15 0) :named _xkassert14))

; --- Invariant 16: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv16 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-Rectangle (TopLevelDeclarations!rect this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv16 0) :named _xkassert15))

; --- Invariant 17: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv17 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TopLevelDeclarations!sum this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv17 0) :named _xkassert16))

; --- Invariant 18: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv18 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (TopLevelDeclarations!isGreater this) true)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv18 0) :named _xkassert17))

; --- Invariant 19: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv19 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (> (TopLevelDeclarations!rectArea this) 0)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv19 0) :named _xkassert18))



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Point:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Point Point)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Point.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point!x this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Point.inv1 1) :named _xkassert19))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Point.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Point!y this) 0)
)

(assert (! (Point.inv2 1) :named _xkassert20))



; ----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Rectangle:
; ----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Rectangle Rectangle)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Rectangle!width this) 10)
)

(assert (! (Rectangle.inv1 2) :named _xkassert21))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Rectangle!height this) 20)
)

(assert (! (Rectangle.inv2 2) :named _xkassert22))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Rectangle!area this) (* (Rectangle!width this) (Rectangle!height this)))
)

(assert (! (Rectangle.inv3 2) :named _xkassert23))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun Rectangle.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Rectangle!perimeter this) (* 2 (+ (Rectangle!width this) (Rectangle!height this))))
)

(assert (! (Rectangle.inv4 2) :named _xkassert24))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        1 (lift-Point const-1-Point))
        2 (lift-Rectangle const-2-Rectangle))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-1-Point () Point
  (mk-Point 0 0))
(define-fun const-2-Rectangle () Rectangle
  (mk-Rectangle 10 20 200 60))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations
  3
  12
  5
  true
  false
  false
  true
  true
  true
  (/ 314159.0 100000.0)
  (/ 5.0 2.0)
  (/ 314159.0 20000.0)
  1
  2
  0
  200))
(define-fun _xkassert13 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (rect (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (rectArea (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
     (area (sel-Rectangle a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert24 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (+ (width (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2)))
              (height (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))))))
  (= (perimeter (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))) (* 2 a!1))))
(define-fun _xkassert22 () Bool
  (= (height (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))) 20))
(define-fun _xkassert14 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (p (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Point a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert6 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (or (isTrue (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
               (isFalse (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (orResult (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert7 () Bool
  (= (isGreater (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (> 5 3)))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (= (difference (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (- 10 5)))
(define-fun _xkassert5 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (and (isTrue (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
                (isFalse (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (andResult (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert19 () Bool
  (= (x (sel-Point (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert9 () Bool
  (= (piValue (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (/ 314159.0 100000.0)))
(define-fun _xkassert21 () Bool
  (= (width (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))) 10))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (sum (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (+ 1 2)))
(define-fun _xkassert8 () Bool
  (= (isEqual (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (= 10 10)))
(define-fun _xkassert10 () Bool
  (= (radius (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (/ 5.0 2.0)))
(define-fun _xkassert20 () Bool
  (= (y (sel-Point (select heap 1))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert17 () Bool
  (= (isGreater (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) true))
(define-fun _xkassert12 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (p (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (px (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (x (sel-Point a!1)))))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (= (isTrue (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) true))
(define-fun _xkassert16 () Bool
  (> (sum (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 0))
(define-fun _xkassert11 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (* 2.0
              (piValue (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0)))
              (radius (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (circumference (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert15 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (rect (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-Rectangle a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert23 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (* (width (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2)))
              (height (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))))))
  (= (area (sel-Rectangle (select heap 2))) a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (product (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) (* 3 4)))
(define-fun _xkassert4 () Bool
  (= (isFalse (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) false))
(define-fun _xkassert18 () Bool
  (> (rectArea (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))) 0))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations
                           (mk-TopLevelDeclarations
                             3
                             12
                             5
                             true
                             false
                             false
                             true
                             true
                             true
                             (/ 314159.0 100000.0)
                             (/ 5.0 2.0)
                             (/ 314159.0 20000.0)
                             1
                             2
                             0
                             200)))
                  1
                  (lift-Point (mk-Point 0 0)))))
  (store a!1 2 (lift-Rectangle (mk-Rectangle 10 20 200 60)))))
